input.summary:
Loft furnished in parts/room-14.mjs: lit smoker focal on the north wall with barrels and lanterns, hay sacks on the west wall, a fence-and-slab worktable with a stair stool, barrel stores on the east side, and a clear lane from the hatch.
Room check says OK: min light 9, 0 dark, 0 dim cells. make.sh wrote a whole build.nbt with 31 placed, no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE writes; the interior render reads as a storage loft.
Not built: hanging cured meats (no ceiling beam known at the loft cells, so nothing to hang chains from) and sacks as anything but hay blocks.
left: Cured meats are not hung; the loft has no known beam or ceiling block to hang iron_chain from yet. Once the roof part's truss positions are built, hanging lanterns or hanging signs could go under them.
One cell at (16,24,21), above the ladder corner, is free but unreachable on the walk grid. The room verdict is still OK.
plan.md Checklist has no loft line; I appended a note to Notes instead of ticking anything.

waste.what: Drew the loft floor and lantern placement as text by hand, then iterated lantern spots by hand after each room check (the first pass left 5 dim cells on the east edge).
waste.cost: 2 make/check cycles, about 4 minutes; the room check's lamp suggestion was applied by hand as two g.set calls.
waste.tool: A lamp-placement helper in the build library: take the room light map from `mcd room` and place standing lanterns on free floor cells until every cell is at least 8, returning the cells used.

waste.what: Checked the loft's furniture and lane coordinates against the floor grid by reading the ASCII plan, with no check that the hatch lane stays clear beyond the room tool's walk result.
waste.cost: about 3 minutes of reading the grid to confirm lanes.
waste.tool: `mcd plan` could mark the hatch and entrance lane cells as reserved, so furniture drawn over them is flagged before a build.

companions.task: Place and balance the loft's light against the room light map: standing lanterns on barrels and the floor, and where a ceiling beam exists, hanging lanterns and candles along the centre line.
Confirm the hatch and ladder foot and head clearances, so the lane from the hatch into the loft stays a clean 2-high route.
